modules.title: 两条 CSS 规则怎样决定按钮的最终颜色
浏览器怎样算出最终样式

items.title: 先看哪些规则匹配
items.text: 选择器决定一条规则是否作用于这个元素。AI 常在标签上写 class="card" 或 className="card"，CSS 里的 .card 就用来匹配它；像 Tailwind 则是直接把 p-4、flex 等原子类名写在标签上，每个类名对应一条具体样式规则。

items.title: 再看哪条声明胜出
items.text: 匹配范围、优先级和书写顺序共同影响结果。开发者工具里的 Styles 和 Computed 面板能显示被覆盖的声明与最后生效的值。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: CSS 负责外观、布局和响应式变化；HTML 负责内容结构，JavaScript 负责交互行为。Flex、Grid 和盒模型是 CSS 中的具体布局概念，不需要把整套布局教程重复放在这里。

lessonPractice.title: 主按钮可以点击，但页面上仍显示灰色。下一步最应该检查什么？

options.label: 检查按钮命中的 CSS 规则和 Computed 最终颜色，找出覆盖来源
options.feedback: 对。按钮行为已经存在，先看匹配和覆盖后的最终值，才能知道主题色在哪一步被替换。

options.label: 重写按钮的点击事件，让点击动作顺便设置主题色
options.feedback: 点击逻辑和静态颜色是两件事；改事件可能掩盖 CSS 覆盖问题，还会让颜色依赖一次点击。

options.label: 把按钮换成另一个 HTML 元素，期待浏览器自动使用主题色
options.feedback: 更换元素不会自动解决样式规则冲突；应先确认选择器是否命中以及哪条声明胜出。

en.title: The primary button is clickable, but it still appears gray. What should you inspect first?

options.label: Inspect the button's matched CSS rules and computed color to find the override
options.feedback: Correct. The button behavior already exists, so inspect matching and the final value to find where the theme color was replaced.

options.label: Rewrite the click handler so the click also sets the theme color
options.feedback: Click behavior and a static color are separate. This can hide the CSS conflict and make the color depend on one click.

options.label: Replace the button with another HTML element and expect the theme color automatically
options.feedback: Changing the element does not resolve a stylesheet conflict. Check selector matching and which declaration wins first.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请检查这个主按钮命中的 CSS 规则和最终 computed style，找出灰色声明覆盖主题色的来源。保留 HTML 结构和点击逻辑，只修正样式，并在桌面和 390px 宽度分别验收颜色、布局和是否溢出。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Inspect the CSS rules matched by this primary button and its final computed style. Find which gray declaration overrides the theme color. Preserve the HTML structure and click behavior, fix only the styling, and verify the color, layout, and overflow at desktop and 390px widths.

learning.assumes: You have seen a page's HTML and encountered a page whose structure is right but whose color, spacing, or layout is wrong.
learning.outcome: You can inspect matched CSS rules and final computed values from a visible symptom, and distinguish styling from HTML structure or JavaScript behavior.

modules.title: How two CSS rules determine a button's final color
How the browser calculates the final style

items.title: First check which rules match
items.text: A selector decides whether a rule applies to an element. AI often generates code with classes like class="card" or utility classes like p-4 and flex in Tailwind, where each class matches specific style rules.

items.title: Then see which declaration wins
items.text: Matching scope, priority, and source order all affect the result. DevTools Styles and Computed panels show crossed-out declarations and the final value.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: CSS controls appearance, layout, and responsive changes; HTML controls content structure, and JavaScript controls interaction behavior. Flex, Grid, and the box model are specific CSS layout concepts, not a second full course here.

distinctions.label: HTML
distinctions.text: {c:html} describes what the page contains and how it is structured; {c:css} describes how that structure looks and lays out.

distinctions.label: JavaScript
distinctions.text: {c:css} changes presentation; {c:javascript} responds to actions and changes behavior or data.
